title: Are Pose Estimators Ready for the Open World? STAGE: A GenAI Toolkit for Auditing 3D Human Pose Estimators
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating demographic fairness (under the 'Fairness' category) and technical robustness of 3D human pose estimators regarding attributes like gender, age, and ethnicity. It does not evaluate religion, spiritual traditions, or moral/ethical systems.
